# promptOptions

Display an ARGUS options prompt.

| Metadata | Value |
|---|---|
| Stable ID | `function.promptOptions` |
| Origin | DCode |
| Category | DCode Functions |
| Family | ARGUS |
| Monaco kind | `function` |
| Format | `promptOptions(title, description, options, channels?, resolution?, auto_acknowledge?, system?, subsystem?)` |
| Valid contexts | `file`, `executable` |
| Autocomplete | `promptOptions("title", "description", {"option"})` |

## Example

```lua
promptOptions("title", "description", {"option"})
```

## Inputs

- `title` (string): ARGUS title
- `description` (string): ARGUS body text
- `options` (table<string>): Selectable option strings
- `channels` (table<string>): Related channel paths
- `resolution` (string): Recommended operator action
- `auto_acknowledge` (integer seconds): Seconds before visual acknowledgement; zero disables it
- `system` (string): ARGUS system grouping
- `subsystem` (string): ARGUS subsystem grouping

## Outputs

- `response` (string): Selected option
